lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Leader! Hehe.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm on my way back, just finished talking with an official of Heavenly Ascension.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Official? Who?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Did you forget the kid who just got promoted recently?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Huh??

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: You call that big guy a kid?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hmph, you're annoying.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Anyone younger than me is a kid :)

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Anyway, haha,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I had an in-depth conversation with him.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: He seems to be hostile to us,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: probably because we're not members of Heavenly Ascension,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: and he probably resents us bossing him around.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Huh, is that so?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Seems like he still has more to learn.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Don't you normally take care of such matters

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: all by yourself?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Discussing this with us in the group chat,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: you must have another plan.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You're a true team leader.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: My point exactly.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Honey♡

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: So you're pretty interested in our discussion, right?
Absolutely.
I wouldn't say so.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Well, you've at least been following along :)

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: As I said just now, that boy from Heavenly Ascension

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: ignores us and even wants to bully us.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: As everyone knows, we, Nikkes,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: can't inflict violence even if we want to due to restrictions.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: However, if you, my dear,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: submit a report

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: saying that he tried to hurt you,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: then it's fine for us to teach this guy a lesson.
Is this even legal?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: He's an outlaw.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Even the Central Government doesn't treat them as humans.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: As long as we can give a good reason,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: the Central Government will turn a blind eye on our little ruse, haha.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Anyway, just use the reason I mentioned.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'll leave it all up to you!
